walkthroughs.title: Get started with Integration Route Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample route file, see its route summary, endpoints and route check, and try the Pro error handling and security review in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.description:
Integration Route Atlas reads Camel routes in the XML DSL (routes, camelContext) and the YAML DSL (- route: and - from:). The sample is an invented order intake with a duplicate route id, a route without id, a password in a URI and an exec endpoint, so every report has something to show.
[Open Sample File](command:integrationRouteAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Run Show Route Summary
steps.description:
The file at a glance: DSL, routes, endpoints and the components they use. The report opens as a new Markdown document; your file is not changed.
[Show Route Summary](command:integrationRouteAtlas.showSummary)

steps.title: Use the other free reports
steps.description:
Every free report works without a key, an account or a network connection: Show Endpoints, Show Route Check.
[Show Endpoints](command:integrationRouteAtlas.showEndpoints)
[Show Route Check](command:integrationRouteAtlas.showRouteCheck)

steps.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
steps.description:
The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer, with no key and no network: Show Error Handling, Show Security Review.
[Show Error Handling](command:integrationRouteAtlas.showErrorHandling)

steps.title: Licence and help
steps.description:
Buy Pro (Personal USD 19, Business USD 39 per user), enter a key, see the licence status, or report a problem.
[Show Licence Status](command:integrationRouteAtlas.licenceStatus)
[Report A Problem](command:integrationRouteAtlas.reportProblem)

integrationRouteAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file (in MB) a report reads, up to 50 MB (VS Code passes files only up to 50 MB to extensions). Larger files are refused with a message.

integrationRouteAtlas.openReportsAsPrevi.markdownDescription: Open each report in the Markdown preview as well as in a new editor.
